name: works-on-my-codex
description: Keep a thin Codex project harness current and configure a native-order TUI status line.

interface.shortDescription: Keep a thin, project-specific Codex harness current.
interface.longDescription: WOMC creates and refreshes a thin project harness as durable project context, local skills, workspaces, and validation commands change. It routes required reading before implementation or a matching task. After hook trust, it also configures the Codex footer with model and reasoning, permission mode, weekly remaining, context remaining, and project.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Works on My Codex harness in this project.
Configure the WOMC status line with model and reasoning, permission mode, weekly remaining, context remaining, and project.
